app.name: Chorus
library.title: Library
library.empty: No Works yet. Import an ebook to start.
jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.connection_lost: Lost the connection to Chorus. Reconnecting…
health.title: Chorus cannot run on this computer yet
health.intro: The startup check found a problem with the graphics card setup or a program Chorus needs:
health.after_fixing: After fixing it, restart Chorus (docker compose restart worker) and reload this page.
health.torch.missing: PyTorch is not installed in the Chorus image.
health.torch.wrong_build: The Chorus image has the wrong PyTorch build ({version}, for CUDA {cuda}). Chorus needs a CUDA 12 build to run on a Pascal card such as the GTX 1050 Ti.
health.torch.no_gpu: No NVIDIA graphics card is visible to Chorus. Check the NVIDIA driver (branch R580) and that Docker gives the worker the GPU.
health.torch.no_kernel: PyTorch {version} has no code for this graphics card ("no kernel image is available"). The image was built with a PyTorch wheel without Pascal support.
health.torch.failed: A test calculation on the graphics card failed.
health.program.missing: The program {program} is missing from the Chorus image.
health.llama.no_gpu: llama.cpp runs, but cannot see the graphics card, so analysis would run on the CPU. A CUDA library is probably missing from the image.
first_run.title: Setting up Chorus
first_run.intro: Chorus is downloading the two models it runs on. This happens once; after that, making audio needs no internet connection.
first_run.after: You can close this page; the download goes on. If Chorus is stopped, it continues where it stopped the next time it starts.
first_run.model.qwen: Qwen3.5-4B, which reads the Work and finds who speaks each line
first_run.error.download: The download stopped: {detail}. Chorus tries again in half a minute; check the internet connection.
first_run.error.hash: A downloaded file was damaged three times in a row. Chorus tries again in half a minute.
voices.title: Voices
import.title: Import
import.intro: Upload an ebook or document: EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, PDF with selectable text, TXT, DOCX, FB2, RTF, ODT and the other formats Calibre can convert. Chorus reads it into a Work you can open from the Library.
import.error.upload_failed: The upload failed. Check that Chorus is running and try again.
import.error.drm: This ebook is protected with DRM, so Chorus cannot read it. Use a copy without DRM.
import.error.unreadable: This file is not an ebook Chorus can open.
import.error.unsupported: Chorus cannot read {name} yet: only EPUB, PDF and TXT files can be imported in this build.
import.error.no_text: This ebook contains no text to read.
import.warning.split_by_headings: The ebook has no table of contents, so it was split into chapters at its headings.
import.warning.split_by_files: The ebook has no table of contents, so each of its files became a chapter.
import.warning.toc_entries_not_found: {count} entries of the table of contents point to places that do not exist in the ebook; their text stays in the chapter before.
work.no_language_pack: Chorus has no Language pack for {language}, so the English pack is used for quotation marks, sentences, chapter headings and Voices.
import.warning.encoding_detected: The file is not UTF-8; it was read as {encoding}, the encoding that fits it best. If letters look wrong, save the file as UTF-8 and import it again.
import.warning.no_chapters: No chapter headings were found, so the whole file is one chapter.
import.error.scanned_pdf: This PDF has no text to read: it looks like a scan, made of page images. Scanned PDFs are not supported; use a PDF with selectable text, or another format.
import.warning.pdf_headers_removed: Running headers or footers were removed on {count} pages.
import.warning.pdf_page_numbers_removed: Page numbers were removed on {count} pages.
import.warning.pdf_pages_without_text: {count} pages have no text (images only) and were skipped.
import.error.unsupported_format: Chorus cannot read this kind of file, and neither can Calibre. Try converting it to EPUB first.
import.error.conversion_failed: Calibre could not convert this file into an ebook Chorus can read.
import.error.conversion_timeout: Converting this file took longer than {minutes} minutes, so it was stopped.
import.error.converter_missing: Calibre's ebook-convert is missing from the Chorus image, so this format cannot be converted.
